claim_boundary: This protocol is designed to discriminate shipping/handling state change from ordinary elapsed-time change. It is not experimental evidence that R2 survives shipping and is not evidence for any quantum mechanism.
principal_hypothesis: After qualification, round-trip transport in the frozen carrier does not produce a practically material change in the selected R2 voltage-loss observable relative to contemporaneous home controls.
conventional_explanation: A cross-facility difference can be caused by shipping, handling, remounting, storage, encapsulation change, contact change, or elapsed ageing rather than facility metrology or device physics.
discriminator: Randomize qualified independent substrates to TRAVEL and HOME arms, measure both arms at facility A before and after the same elapsed interval, and estimate a difference-in-changes shipping effect.

observable.measurement_requirement: Use the same qualified facility-A configuration, analysis commit, injection point, temperature point, calibration lineage, and QC rules for PRE and POST measurements.
observable.sign_convention: Positive change means larger nonradiative voltage loss after the interval.

design.randomization: Randomize qualified substrates to TRAVEL or HOME after qualification and before PRE outcome review beyond QC eligibility.
design.travel_arm: Pack in the frozen v3.35 carrier/insert, execute the intended A-to-B-to-A handling/shipping route or representative dry run, then remeasure at facility A.
design.home_arm: Remain at facility A under logged storage conditions for the same elapsed interval and undergo the same PRE/POST measurement/remount sequence without shipment.
design.minimum_count_class: synthetic planning result under the frozen normal-approximation assumptions below; not a universal sample-size requirement
design.blinding: Use blind substrate IDs in the analysis table. Arm identity may be operationally unavoidable during packing but should be hidden from the analyst until QC exclusions are frozen.
design.hierarchy: lot -> substrate -> device/pixel -> session -> measurement; substrate is the independent unit for the arm comparison

estimator.shipping_effect: Delta_ship = mean(d_i for TRAVEL) - mean(d_i for HOME)
estimator.units: d_i, Delta_ship, s, and SE are all mV
estimator.decision_screen: Report estimate, SE, and 95% normal-approximation interval as an engineering screen only. Do not describe it as publication-grade equivalence evidence at small N.
estimator.practical_effect_scale_class: engineering planning scale inherited from the program's 5 mV R2 transfer/fabrication precision target; not a standards-derived limit

synthetic_power_plan.distribution: independent Normal substrate-level PRE-to-POST changes with common SD sigma_change_mV within each arm
synthetic_power_plan.sigma_change_class: synthetic planning assumption, not measured R2 variability
synthetic_power_plan.useful_negative_result: Three substrates per arm has only about 0.5324 synthetic power for a 5 mV effect when sigma_change=3 mV, so a tiny shipping screen can easily miss a practically material effect under the nominal model.
synthetic_power_plan.software_requirement: Standard-library Python; deterministic closed-form calculation, no Monte Carlo.

allowed_exclusions: unsafe or visibly damaged state that makes measurement invalid
missing required PRE or POST primary outcome

status_semantics.PASS_SCREEN: Required data are complete and the engineering screen does not show a material shipping effect; this is not proof of equivalence.
status_semantics.FAIL_SCREEN: Observed shipping-control result is materially adverse under the frozen screen or a required safety/handling gate fails.
status_semantics.INCOMPLETE: Required data, provenance, or configuration evidence is missing.

limiting_cases: If every TRAVEL and HOME substrate changes by the same amount, Delta_ship = 0 regardless of that common ageing drift.
If every TRAVEL substrate changes by +5 mV and every HOME substrate changes by 0 mV, Delta_ship = +5 mV.
If arm labels are swapped, Delta_ship changes sign but not magnitude.
Repeated pixels/sessions on one substrate can improve measurement precision but do not increase n_TRAVEL or n_HOME.

rules: Use the reviewed v3.35 carrier/insert and facility-approved packaging before qualified primaries travel.
Do not use randomization to override shipping, EHS, electrical, optical, or handling constraints.
Log storage and shipping deviations; do not discard adverse excursions merely because they complicate interpretation.
Preserve damaged or failed samples and their records when safe to do so.

provenance.note: No new external empirical capability or performance claim is introduced. Numerical variability and power inputs are synthetic planning assumptions.
